jobs.title: Senior Business Development Manager – Public Sector
jobs.description:
Back to jobs Senior Business Development Manager – Public Sector Germany | Remote Apply Job description Team & Reporting Line: Our Mission At constellr, we use thermal intelligence from space to understand what is happening on Earth - where, when and at scale. Our satellite constellation delivers high-resolution land surface temperature data, giving governments, defence organisations, commercial operators and global institutions the intelligence they need to monitor change, assess risk and make better-informed decisions. From national security and critical infrastructure to agriculture and climate resilience, constellr turns temperature into actionable intelligence for a changing world. Your Role As our Senior Business Development Manager for the Public Sector, you will join the Commercial team and lead constellr’s growth with civil government customers – environmental ministries, national and regional agencies, and European institutions – who need reliable, decision-grade thermal intelligence to manage water, agriculture, infrastructure and climate resilience. This is not a data-reselling role. You will sell data intelligence and analytics: understanding what public bodies are trying to achieve, shaping how our land surface temperature products and insights fit their mandates, and guiding them through funding cycles and formal procurement. You will work closely with our Product, Earth observation science and Solutions teams to translate remote sensing capability into solutions that answer real governmental needs, and alongside colleagues covering commercial, industrial and defence markets to build a coherent go-to-market across the business. You will own a strategic portfolio from first conversation to signed contract, including major upcoming national and EU tenders, and build on constellr’s existing success in European programmes such as Copernicus. With the launch of the world’s first commercial thermal infrared constellation, the relationships you build and the deals you win will define how governments use thermal data for years to come. Key responsibilities Public-Sector Growth: Own and grow constellr’s civil public-sector business, developing a targeted pipeline across environmental ministries, national agencies, research-funded programmes and European institutions. Selling Data Intelligence: Lead value-based sales of thermal data, analytics and insight services, positioning solutions around customer outcomes rather than raw imagery. Tenders & Procurement: Identify , qualify and lead responses to public tenders and framework calls, working with procurement and tender teams and coordinating internal bid teams through to submission and negotiation. Funding Cycles & Programmes: Map national, EU and ESA funding cycles, programmes and budget timelines, and shape opportunities early so constellr is positioned well ahead of formal procurement. Proposal Management: Lead proposals for funded programmes, framework contracts and consortium bids – from opportunity strategy and partner selection through to compelling, compliant submissions. Stakeholder Engagement: Build trusted, senior relationships with decision-makers , technical users and procurement officers, speaking credibly to each audience. Science-to-Market: Act as the bridge between science and customers – partner with our scientists and product teams to translate remote sensing capabilities into clear use cases, pilots and solution proposals that meet governmental requirements. Commercial Leadership: Hold your ground in complex negotiations, protect deal value and represent constellr confidently in front of senior public officials. Partnerships & Ecosystem: Develop relationships with research institutes, system integrators and geospatial partners to access and win larger public programmes. Market Intelligence: Feed customer and market insight back into product, pricing and commercial strategy, and represent constellr at key conferences and public-sector events. Forecasting & Reporting: Maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast in our CRM and deliver against agreed commercial targets. Job requirements About you Required: Significant (typically 8+ years) experience in business development or sales of geospatial, Earth observation or data analytics solutions, with a strong track record selling to civil public-sector customers. Proven experience winning public tenders and navigating government procurement, funding cycles and budget processes. A solid understanding of remote sensing and how satellite-derived data and analytics are used to meet governmental needs. An advanced degree (MSc or PhD) in physics, geoscience, remote sensing or a related STEM field – or equivalent experience – giving you credibility with technical and scientific stakeholders. Strong proposal and bid management experience, ideally including EU, ESA or nationally funded programmes and consortium bids. Experience selling data intelligence, analytics or information services rather than hardware or raw data alone. The ability to bridge science and industry, with a senior, confident presence – able to stand your ground in negotiations and build credibility with ministry-level stakeholders. An established network across European public-sector, research or geospatial communities. Excellent communication skills in English and German. Willingness to travel regularly for customer meetings, public-sector events and industry conferences. Nice to Have : Experience selling into defence, security or dual-use programmes. A background in an applied research institute, geoscience or remote sensing environment. Exposure to security research, resilience or critical infrastructure programmes. Familiarity with European programmes such as Copernicus, ESA or EU-funded research and innovation calls. Experience in technology transfer, innovation management or strategic roles within public-sector or research organisations. Additional European languages, particularly French. Experience in a fast-growing New Space or scale-up company. Why join constellr? High-Impact National Security Mission: Be part of an ambitious mission to launch the world’s first commercial thermal infrared constellation, delivering sovereign-grade "behavioural" intelligence from space to close critical blind spots for defence, intelligence, and maritime surveillance agencies. Fast-Paced "New Space" Innovation: Work at the leading edge of a rapidly evolving defence sector. By leveraging modern, agile New Space methodologies, you will help design, build, and deploy dual-use thermal payloads into operational orbit at a speed and scale that traditional aerospace models simply cannot match. Broad Interdisciplinary Exposure: Accelerate your professional growth by collaborating daily with a diverse, international cohort of astrophysicists, software developers, and defence-system engineers. Inclusive & Scientific Culture: Join a high-trust team deeply committed to diversity, inclusion, and scientific excellence, where academic curiosity is paired with high autonomy and a flat hierarchy. Financial Upside & Well-being: Benefit from a Virtual Share Option Plan (VSOP) for permanent employees, giving you a true stake in the company's growth, alongside highly flexible hybrid working models. Back to jobs Government Relations - Germany Munich | On-site Apply Job description Team & Reporting Line: Our Mission At constellr, we're harnessing the power of space to solve one of Earth’s greatest challenges: climate resilience & security in a changing world. Our thermal satellite constellation delivers the most accurate land surface temperature data on the market, equipping commercial players, governments, defence agencies, and global institutions with the thermal intelligence they need to make strategic decisions – from national security and infrastructure to agriculture and climate resilience. This is not a concept on a slide. Our first two SkyBee satellites have been in orbit since 2025, each flying a cryocooled thermal infrared instrument on a microsatellite, and our next satellites are already in the pipeline. Backed by a €37M Series A, we are now opening a new site in Munich to bring assembly, integration and test (AIT) in-house. With offices in Brussels, Freiburg, Munich, Berlin and Toulouse, our multidisciplinary team of engineers, scientists and strategists is turning flight data from orbit into the next generation of thermal satellites. Your Role You will lead constellr’s senior-level engagement with national and regional government, public authorities, defence organisations and space institutions within Germany. This is an important, externally focused role requiring credibility, autonomy and an established government and political network. You will represent constellr with senior stakeholders, develop trusted long-term relationships and support the identification, influence and capture of strategic government and sovereign opportunities. Building an effective working bridge between constellr’s government team and our commercial, product and technical teams, you will translate political influence, policy and budget developments and our technology and product roadmap into long-term strategic capability programmes for the German government. The role is based in our new Berlin office, with regular travel to our Munich HQ and across Germany and Europe. Key responsibilities Lead constellr’s government relations and political stakeholder engagement for Germany, at both parliamentary and ministerial levels. Build constellr’s engagement along the federal budget cycle, from ministry planning to the Budget Committee and its rapporteurs, so that capability needs turn into budget lines and funded programmes. Bring constellr into interministerial coordination on space and security policy (Federal Foreign Office, BMVg, BMFTR, Federal Chancellery) and into German-led international formats such as NATO, EU and Ukraine support programmes. Develop and maintain trusted relationships with the strategic, operational, administrative, subject-matter and budget units within the German Government and beyond, including ministries, government agencies, committees, political associations and other relevant public-sector stakeholders. Identify, qualify and shape strategic programmes, procurements, partnerships and collaborative opportunities from an early stage to ensure relevance and sponsorship for constellr. Support capture activities through stakeholder mapping, positioning and outreach, intelligence gathering and partner coordination. Work with technical, product and commercial teams to translate customer requirements into credible mission concepts, proposals and partnership models. Provide structured regional intelligence on policy, procurement, budgets, institutional developments and competitor activity. Advise constellr’s leadership on national positioning, engagement priorities and partnership strategy. Represent constellr at relevant industry events, government forums, conferences and bilateral engagements, and host national events with key stakeholders. Ensure all national engagement is conducted in line with constellr’s legal, compliance, security and export control requirements, including the transparency obligations of the German Lobbying Register Act (Lobbyregistergesetz). Job requirements About you Required: You are credible and confident in senior government and industry environments, while being collegiate and effective in a fast-paced international organisation. You are politically astute, discreet and able to build long-term, trust-based institutional relationships, while being commercially minded, proactive and disciplined in execution. You know how positions are coordinated between ministries and with international partners, and you can translate complex technology into the language of foreign, security and budget policy. You are motivated by complex missions with strategic, societal and security relevance. Required: At least 7 years in German federal politics or government, ideally in one of these roles: Federal Foreign Office: diplomat with experience in security policy, NATO or EU affairs or Central and Eastern Europe, ideally including a posting abroad. Bundestag: staffer to a Member of the Bundestag, a parliamentary group or a committee secretariat, ideally Budget, Defence, Foreign Affairs or Research/Space. Federal budget: experience in a ministry budget unit (e.g. BMVg, BMFTR, Federal Ministry of Finance) or supporting Budget Committee rapporteurs. You know how a programme becomes a budget line. Industry: senior government affairs at a defence, space or security company or industry association with a strong federal track record. An exceptional political network and the ability to leverage relationships effectively and wisely. Demonstrable experience in identifying, shaping and securing complex government opportunities and public-sector programmes. A deep understanding of government decision-making, procurement processes and institutional stakeholder dynamics. Excellent communication, negotiation and executive stakeholder management skills. A team player, able to share and leverage knowledge to constellr’s advantage while operating autonomously, with sound judgement and sensitivity. A collaborative, structured and highly driven working style. German at native or C2 level and business-fluent English (C1 or higher). Willingness to travel regularly across Germany and Europe. Nice to Have : Previous senior experience within defence, intelligence, national security or sovereign space programmes. Knowledge of Earth observation, satellite systems, ISR, geospatial intelligence or advanced sensing technologies. Experience working with European, NATO or multinational government programmes. Experience in German-Ukrainian government, security or industry cooperation. French at working level. Why join constellr? High-Impact National Security Mission: Be part of an ambitious mission to launch the world’s first commercial thermal infrared constellation, delivering sovereign-grade "behavioural" intelligence from space to close critical blind spots for defence, intelligence, and maritime surveillance agencies. Fast-Paced "New Space" Innovation: Work at the leading edge of a rapidly evolving defence sector. By leveraging modern, agile New Space methodologies, you will help design, build, and deploy dual-use thermal payloads into operational orbit at a speed and scale that traditional aerospace models simply cannot match. Broad Interdisciplinary Exposure: Accelerate your professional growth by collaborating daily with a diverse, international cohort of astrophysicists, software developers, and defence-system engineers. Inclusive & Scientific Culture: Join a high-trust team deeply committed to diversity, inclusion, and scientific excellence, where academic curiosity is paired with high autonomy and a flat hierarchy. jobs.title: Payload Data Processing Engineer
jobs.description:
Back to jobs Payload Data Processing Engineer Berlin | On-site Apply Job description Team & Reporting Line: Image Processing Our Mission At constellr, we use thermal intelligence from space to understand what is happening on Earth - where, when and at scale. Our satellite constellation delivers high-resolution land surface temperature data, giving governments, defence organisations, commercial operators and global institutions the intelligence they need to monitor change, assess risk and make better-informed decisions. From national security and critical infrastructure to agriculture and climate resilience, constellr turns temperature into actionable intelligence for a changing world. Your Role We are looking for a Payload Data Engineer to bridge the gap between our satellite payloads, onboard processing and ground-based image processing. You will work at the intersection of sensor physics, electronics, spacecraft systems, signal processing and software . Your role is to understand how the imaging instrument and spacecraft generate data, how this behavior affects our processing algorithms, and how processing concepts can be optimized for future onboard implementation. You will be a key technical interface between payload, satellite/DPU and ground processing , working across VNIR, SWIR, MWIR and TIR imaging systems. Key responsibilities Develop a deep understanding of the payload data, metadata, imaging modes and detector behavior, and of how detector, optical and electronics design influences processing algorithms and product quality. Work with TDI and block-TDI concepts and translate instrument operating modes into appropriate processing-chain designs. Follow data from L0 to L1C and trace artifacts and anomalies from the ground product back to their detector, electronics or spacecraft origin. Analyze timing, synchronization and telemetry , including multiple clocks, PPS synchronization, drift, offsets, temperatures, attitude and pointing information. Develop sensor and payload-data simulators for new satellite systems, including realistic data formats, metadata, timing behavior and imaging artifacts. Support instrument characterization, commissioning and in-orbit performance analysis. Contribute to the design of next-generation onboard processing , potentially up to L1C, taking into account DPU and platform constraints such as compute, memory, power, data rate, latency, real-time and deterministic processing, and radiation. Adapt ground algorithms to the constraints of the onboard processor. You define what the algorithm must look like to fit the hardware. This may include moving prototypes from Python to C++ or Rust. Act as a technical bridge between payload/satellite engineering and operations and the ground processing . jobs.description: Back to jobs Students & Interns Munich | On-site Apply Are you a student looking for an internship, a working student (Werkstudent) role or your thesis project in the space industry? We’d love to hear from you. About constellr At constellr, we build and operate our own constellation of thermal infrared satellites. From orbit, we measure the temperature of the Earth’s surface with high precision and turn that data into insights that help our customers make better decisions, from agriculture and water management to climate resilience, infrastructure and security. We’re a fast-growing European New Space company with teams in Germany and Belgium and our main hub in Munich. Our people work across everything it takes to run a satellite business: designing missions, flying satellites, processing imagery, building software and bringing our data to customers around the world. Why join us as a student? You’ll do real work that matters, not coffee runs. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers, scientists and business experts who are happy to share what they know. You’ll see how a space company works from the inside, from satellite operations to product and commercial teams. And you’ll get the chance to grow with us, since many great hires start as students. Who we’re looking for You’re currently enrolled at a university or college, or about to start an internship, working student position or thesis. You’re curious, motivated and keen to learn. Your field doesn’t have to be aerospace: we have opportunities across engineering, data, software, operations, finance, people, communications and more. How to apply Join our Students & Interns talent community by completing the short application form below. To help us get your profile in front of the right team: Upload your CV. Make sure it includes your field of study and expected graduation date. Choose the team you’re most interested in from the dropdown list. Tell us where you’d be able to work. What happens next? Your profile will be shared with the team you’ve chosen. This isn’t an application for a specific role. Instead, whenever an internship, working student or thesis opportunity opens that matches your interests, we’ll reach out to you directly. We review every profile, but because we receive many applications, we may not be able to respond to everyone individually. Your privacy We’ll keep your details for up to 24 months so we can contact you about future opportunities. You can withdraw your consent and have your data deleted at any time by emailing dpo@constellr.com . Our Privacy Policy explains how we handle your data.
